function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check available appointment slots for a given date and service type. Call this tool BEFORE booking to verify the requested time slot is available.

preferred_date.description: The date to check in ISO format (e.g., 2026-06-15)

service_type.description: The type of appointment to check availability for

function.name: create_appointment
function.description: Create a new appointment for a patient at Modera Dental Clinic. Call this tool when you have collected all the necessary information from the caller and they have confirmed the details.

full_name.description: The patient's full name (first and last name)

is_new_customer.description: True if this is a new patient, False if existing

service_type.description: The type of appointment service requested

scheduled_at.description: The appointment date and time in ISO format (e.g., 2026-06-15T10:00)

reason.description: A brief description of why the patient is coming in

urgency.description: The urgency level of the appointment

function.name: lookup_appointment
function.description: Look up an existing appointment for a patient by name and phone number.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date and time.

appointment_id.description: The ID of the appointment to reschedule

new_datetime.description: The new date and time in ISO format

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel an existing appointment. Pass all fields returned by lookup_appointment.

record_id.description: The appointment record id from lookup_appointment

customer.description: The customer full name from lookup_appointment

function.name: end_call
function.description: End the current call. Use when the caller says goodbye or has no more questions.

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Transfer the caller to a live staff member. Use when the caller explicitly asks for a real person, has billing disputes, complaints, or complex clinical questions.

reason.description: Brief description of why the transfer is needed
